intent: A minimal footer, near-black by default with a warm-paper light theme, centred on one email capture whose shell morphs field → circle spinner → inverted success pill, with kind validation, typo hints, already-subscribed and error-with-retry states, revealed once on scroll.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries
stack.animation: motion/react: variants with a shared reveal timeline (useInView), shared layout shell, AnimatePresence popLayout, useAnimate shake, pathLength check, motion-value count-up

layout.root: footer @container; palette as CSS variables; 1px ink/10 top rule; max-w 1200px; gutters 20/40px; pt 64→96px
layout.column: centred, max-w 560px: kicker, serif title, body (46ch), form 36px below
layout.shell: max-w 460px × 56px, radius 28px, field colour, inset ink/13% ring; input 16px with 20px left pad; 44px ink submit pill
layout.messageLine: reserves 44px under the shell for note / hint / error / status
layout.bottomRow: ink/10 rule; socials left (RSS icon, external ↗), legal + Privacy/Terms right; stacked and centred below @4xl

color.approach: monochrome; loading/success invert the shell to ink; the error colour is the only hue
color.error: ring 60%, halo 12%, dot and message text

motion.reveal: once per block at 25% visible; shared clock so blocks arriving together play in order and later ones start at once; rise 12px + blur 8px → 0, 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
motion.timeline: top rule draws 0 (scaleX 800ms) → kicker 60ms → title words from 120ms, 35ms apart → body 300ms → shell 380ms → note 460ms → reader count 0 → 4,812 from 620ms over 700ms with a 3px blur settle; bottom row at 500ms: rule, socials 40ms apart, legal last
motion.invalid: x [0,-7,6,-4,2,0] 420ms; ring turns error colour; specific message
motion.loading: shell layout to 56px circle, 500ms cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); field blurs out 180ms; spinner fades in at 320ms; minimum 700ms
motion.success: circle grows to auto-width ink pill; badge spring 500/32; check pathLength 380ms; words in with 5px rise + 4px blur, 360ms, 35ms stagger from 280ms
motion.error: field-coloured pill with error ring, message + Retry; retry icon −90° on hover
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; count set instantly; no shake, blur or offsets; instant layout

responsive.desktop: centred column; bottom row split left/right
responsive.mobile: shell full width; success copy wraps inside the pill; bottom row stacked and centred; 44px targets

accessibility: real form with visually hidden label, type=email, autocomplete=email
aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the message line
focus moves to Retry on error and to the message line on success
Use a different email clears and refocuses the field
title read once from an sr-only copy; staggered words aria-hidden

content.title: One good email, every Thursday.
content.body: Field notes on making software people keep. Four minutes to read, no tracking pixels, one-click unsubscribe.
content.success: You’re on the list. First issue Thursday.
content.already: You’re already on the list. See you Thursday.
content.legal: © 2026 Pressroom Labs ApS. Written in Copenhagen.
content.onSubscribe: (email) => Promise<'subscribed' | 'already-subscribed' | void>; reject for the error state

avoid: modals, confetti or toasts for success
red borders before the first submit
a spinner that resizes the control
accent colours, glow or tinted washes
an entrance that animates the whole footer as one block
per-frame React state for the count
